figures.caption: FIG. 1. a) Schematic illustration of the optical coupling between the resonant waveguide structure and the exciton emitter in the thin InSe film on top of it. b) Cross-section of the electric near-field distribution in the center of the studied structure at the resonant wavelength

FIG. 2. Calculated spectra of the coupling coefficient (a) and Purcell factor (b) the electric OP dipole placed on top of the RW structure. All spectra are normalized on respective spectra of the CW structure
FIG. 3. a) Scanning electron microscope (SEM) image of the RW. b) Scaled SEM image of the resonant section of the RW c) Optical image of the transferred flake on the RW

FIG. 5. Results of µ-PL measurements. The sketches above the graphs show implemented schemes. a) µ-PL spectra of InSe flake lying on the planar substrate (blue curve), the CW (red curve) and the RW (green curve) measured in the back-scattering scheme. b) µ-PL spectra of luminescence signal excited in the center of the waveguide and collected from the grating for the CW (red curve) and the RW (green curve) structures.

FIG. 6. a) PL decay curves in logarithmic scale. The blue curve corresponds to PL of the InSe flake on the planar substrate, the green curve shows the PL kinetic of InSe measured on the center of the RW in the back-scattering configuration, the red curve shows the PL kinetic of InSe measured from the grating (solid lines represent exponential fitting). b) Recombination lifetimes, extracted from TRPL data in top Figure, in logarithmic scale. Red and blue bars correspond to fast and medium components, respectively.
